content.stem: 外国资产控制办公室(OFAC)负责:

options.A: 确保有效的出口管制和条约遵守制度
options.B: 实施和执行经济及贸易制裁
options.C: 将某些司法管辖区指定为主要洗钱关切对象
options.D: 管理美国与外国之间的贸易协定

content.stem_en: The Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) is responsible for:

options_en.A: Ensuring an effective export control and treaty compliance system
options_en.B: Administering and enforcing economic and trade sanctions
options_en.C: Designating certain jurisdictions as primary money laundering concerns
options_en.D: Managing trade agreements between the U.S. and foreign countries
